prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster background asset for a Chinese xianxia Unreal game HUD. Hand-painted Chinese shuimo ink wash on warm gray-beige xuan paper, celadon mist, graphite ink mountains. A delicate fine antique-gold metal rectangular border, restrained small geometric gold corner detailing, fully visible complete outer frame with ample safety padding. Refined, atmospheric, consistent with black calligraphy and gold cultivation ornaments. NOT plain white, NOT a modern UI card. No text, no symbols, no portraits, no meters, no icons, no buttons, no labels. The interior is opaque paper with visible natural fibers and soft ink gradients; only outside the panel is transparent. Orthographic flat front view, no perspective or cast shadow. A single WIDE HORIZONTAL status-namecard panel, width:height exactly 2.24:1, ideally 1792x800 within a transparent image. Keep 80% of the interior quiet warm paper for a live avatar on the left and three live meters on the right. Subtle but clearly visible ink-wash mountain silhouettes and a bamboo sprig concentrated at the lower corners, fading smoothly into the empty central field. Thin single fine gold outline surrounding the entire panel with 2% inset from image edges. Entire border must be within the output, no crop.
